name: canvas-lms-mcp-remote

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Get your Canvas user ID, name and login. Read-only and very cheap. Use it to confirm the token works; use get_my_profile for bio and email, or test_connection for a full diagnostic.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your full Canvas profile: name, bio, avatar, primary email and calendar feed URL. Read-only. For just your ID and name, whoami is cheaper.

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.description: Get your account-level Canvas preferences, such as dashboard view, activity stream visibility and comment notification settings. Read-only. For how often you are notified about each event, use get_notification_preferences.

tools.name: check_token_expiry
tools.description: Check when your Canvas access token expires and warn if it is close. Read-only. Canvas often forces student tokens to expire after 30–120 days without warning, so run this at the start of a term.

tools.name: get_rate_limit_status
tools.description: Report Canvas rate-limit state from the most recent API call: remaining quota, last request cost and requests this session. Read-only and makes no Canvas call itself. Canvas throttles by cumulative request cost, so check this before expensive tools like semester_snapshot.

tools.name: list_my_enrollments
tools.description: List your enrollments across all courses, with role (student, observer…), section and current grade summary. Read-only. Use list_courses for course details; use this when you need roles, sections or per-enrollment grades.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_activity_stream
tools.description: Get recent activity across all your courses: new announcements, discussion replies, graded submissions and messages, newest first. Read-only. Titles and messages are fenced as untrusted text. For counts only, use get_activity_stream_summary; for one course, use get_course_activity_stream.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

only_active_courses.description: Only include activity from currently active courses. Default true.

tools.name: get_activity_stream_summary
tools.description: Get counts of unread activity by type (announcements, discussions, messages, submissions) across your courses. Read-only and very cheap. Call it before get_activity_stream to see whether the full stream is worth pulling.

tools.name: list_todo
tools.description: List Canvas's own to-do items for you: assignments waiting for your submission, and items to grade if you are an instructor. Read-only. For a date-bounded view use list_upcoming_assignments; for one course use list_todo_for_course.

tools.name: get_todo_count
tools.description: Get the number of items on your Canvas to-do list without fetching them. Read-only and cheap. Use list_todo to see the items.

tools.name: list_upcoming_events
tools.description: List your upcoming calendar events and assignment due dates, using Canvas's own default window. Read-only. For a specific date range, use list_calendar_events.

tools.name: get_dashboard_cards
tools.description: Get the course cards on your Canvas dashboard, in dashboard order, with names, colors and links. Read-only. Use list_courses for every enrollment, including ones not on the dashboard.

tools.name: list_favorite_courses
tools.description: List the courses you have starred as favorites; these decide what appears on your dashboard. Read-only. Change them with add_favorite_course and remove_favorite_course.

tools.name: add_favorite_course
tools.description: Star a course as a favorite so it shows on your Canvas dashboard. Only affects your own view. Reverse with remove_favorite_course.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: remove_favorite_course
tools.description: Unstar a favorite course so it no longer shows on your Canvas dashboard. Only affects your own view; your enrollment is unchanged. Reverse with add_favorite_course.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_communication_channels
tools.description: List the notification channels on your account (email addresses, SMS numbers, push) with their IDs and status. Read-only. Use a channel_id from here with get_notification_preferences.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Get how often Canvas notifies you about each event type (due dates, grades, announcements…) on one channel: immediately, daily, weekly or never. Read-only. Get channel_id from get_communication_channels first.

channel_id.description: Communication channel ID (numeric string). Get it from get_communication_channels.

tools.name: get_my_page_views
tools.description: List your own Canvas page views (URL, time and course) in a time range. Read-only. Useful for showing you opened material on a given date. How far back history goes depends on your school.

end_time.description: End of the range, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: list_content_shares
tools.description: List course content (assignments, pages, quizzes) that other Canvas users shared directly with you, with sender and share date. Read-only. Returns an empty list if nothing was shared.

tools.name: get_custom_data
tools.description: Read key-value data you previously stored on your Canvas account with set_custom_data. Read-only. Returns an error if nothing is stored at that namespace and scope.

scope.description: Optional path inside the namespace, e.g. "settings/theme". Omit to read everything in the namespace.

tools.name: set_custom_data
tools.description: Store your own key-value data on your Canvas account (a small private per-user store, invisible to others). Overwrites any existing value at the same namespace and scope. Read it back with get_custom_data.

data.description: JSON object to store, e.g. {"theme": "dark"}. Replaces whatever is already stored at this scope.

namespace.description: Namespace that keeps your data apart from other apps. Defaults to "canvas-mcp".

scope.description: Optional path inside the namespace, e.g. "settings/theme".

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: List your saved Canvas bookmarks with their names, URLs and IDs. Read-only. Use the IDs with delete_bookmark.

tools.name: create_bookmark
tools.description: Save a Canvas bookmark to a course page or any Canvas URL. Only you see it. Returns the new bookmark with its ID. Use list_bookmarks to see existing ones.

name.description: Label for the bookmark, e.g. "BIO 101 syllabus".

position.description: Optional position in the bookmark list (1 = first).

tools.name: delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete one of your saved Canvas bookmarks. Only affects you. Get bookmark_id from list_bookmarks.

bookmark_id.description: Bookmark ID (numeric string). Get it from list_bookmarks.

tools.name: list_my_observees
tools.description: List the students you are linked to as an observer, for parent or mentor accounts. Read-only. Returns an empty list for regular student accounts.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the courses you are enrolled in with IDs, names, codes, term and your current grade. Read-only. Only active courses unless include_concluded is set. Start here to get course_id values for other tools.

include_concluded.description: If true, also include courses from finished terms.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Get full details for one course: name, code, term, start and end dates, syllabus and public description. Read-only. Use list_courses to find course IDs; use get_syllabus for the syllabus as plain text.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_syllabus
tools.description: Get a course syllabus as plain text, converted from Canvas HTML. Read-only. The text is fenced as untrusted. If the instructor uploaded the syllabus as a file instead, look in list_course_files; syllabus_digest pulls out dates and weights.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_course_settings
tools.description: Get course-level settings such as whether final grades are hidden, the late policy is shown, or a grading standard is used. Read-only. Some settings may be hidden from students, in which case Canvas returns an error.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_course_tabs
tools.description: List the navigation tabs visible to you in a course (Home, Assignments, Files, Quizzes…). Read-only. Check this first to see whether a feature such as Files or Pages is enabled before calling its tools.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_course_activity_stream
tools.description: Get recent activity in one course: announcements, discussion replies, grade changes and messages. Read-only. Titles and messages are fenced as untrusted. For all courses at once, use get_activity_stream.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the sections in a course (e.g. lecture or lab sections), including the one you are enrolled in. Read-only. Useful for understanding section-specific due-date overrides.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_course_users
tools.description: List people in a course with names, roles and user IDs, optionally filtered by role or name. Read-only. Your school's privacy settings often limit or block this for students.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_user_in_course
tools.description: Get one person's profile within a course: name, role, section and avatar. Read-only. Get user_id from list_course_users. Your institution's privacy settings may limit what is returned.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_course_permissions
tools.description: Show what your token is allowed to do in a course, such as posting to discussions or sending messages. Read-only. Call it before a write tool to avoid an action failing halfway.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_course_nicknames
tools.description: List the personal nicknames you have given courses. Read-only. Only you see nicknames. Change them with set_course_nickname or remove_course_nickname.

tools.name: set_course_nickname
tools.description: Give a course a personal nickname that replaces its name in your own Canvas view. Only you see it; the course is unchanged for everyone else. Undo with remove_course_nickname.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

nickname.description: The nickname to show for this course. Only you see it.

tools.name: remove_course_nickname
tools.description: Remove your personal nickname for a course so Canvas shows its official name again. Only affects your own view.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_course_progress
tools.description: Get your module completion progress in a course: requirements met, total requirements and next item. Read-only. Returns an error for courses without module completion requirements.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_todo_for_course
tools.description: List Canvas to-do items for a single course. Read-only. Use list_todo for all courses at once.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_blackout_dates
tools.description: List no-work days (blackout dates) in a course used by course pacing. Read-only. Returns an empty list when pacing is not used.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: List assignments in a course with due dates, points and your submission status, optionally filtered by bucket (e.g. upcoming, overdue) or name. Read-only. Use get_assignment for one assignment's full instructions and rubric.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_assignment
tools.description: Get full details for one assignment: instructions, due/lock dates, points, submission types and the rubric. Read-only. Prompt text written by the instructor is fenced as untrusted. Get assignment_id from list_assignments.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: list_assignment_groups
tools.description: List a course's assignment groups (e.g. Homework, Exams) with their grade weights and drop rules, optionally with each group's assignments. Read-only. Explains how your final grade is weighted; get_course_grade_breakdown does the math for you.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

include_assignments.description: If true, include each group's assignments in the result.

tools.name: get_assignment_group
tools.description: Get one assignment group (e.g. "Homework") with its weight, drop rules and assignments. Read-only. Use list_assignment_groups to see all groups and their IDs.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

group_id.description: Assignment group ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignment_groups.

tools.name: list_assignment_overrides
tools.description: List due-date overrides on an assignment: different dates or extensions for sections, groups or individual students. Read-only. Use get_my_override for the dates that apply to you.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_my_override
tools.description: Get the due, lock and unlock dates that actually apply to you for an assignment, after section or individual overrides. Read-only. Use this instead of the default dates when deadlines differ by section.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_assignment_dates
tools.description: List due, lock and unlock dates for every assignment in a course, sorted by due date, in a compact form. Read-only. Use list_assignments when you also need submission status.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_score_statistics
tools.description: Get class statistics for an assignment (mean, min, max, quartiles) next to your own score. Read-only. Canvas only shows these once enough students are graded and if the instructor allows it.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_late_policy
tools.description: Get a course's late policy: the percentage deducted per late interval, the lowest score a late penalty can reach, and the grade given for missing work. Read-only. Returns an error if the course has no late policy.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_missing_submissions
tools.description: List every assignment Canvas has flagged as missing across all your courses, with due date, points and how overdue it is. Read-only. One call instead of looping over courses. list_overdue_assignments checks submission status course by course instead.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: list_upcoming_assignments
tools.description: List assignments and other planner items due in the next N days (default 7) across all active courses, soonest first. Read-only. Uses the same Planner feed as the Canvas dashboard; set include_completed to also show items already done.

include_completed.description: If true, also include assignments you have already submitted.

tools.name: list_overdue_assignments
tools.description: List assignments past their due date that you have not submitted, checking each active course. Read-only. Slower than list_missing_submissions, which relies on Canvas's own missing flag, but catches items without that flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_my_submission
tools.description: Get your submission for one assignment: score, grade, submitted time, lateness and deductions, attachments and instructor comments. Read-only. Use get_submission_history for earlier attempts.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: list_my_submissions
tools.description: List all of your submissions in a course with scores, grades and status. Read-only. Use get_my_submission for full detail on one.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_submission_summary
tools.description: Get counts of graded, ungraded and not-submitted submissions for an assignment. Read-only. Often instructor-only, so students may get a permission error.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_submission_history
tools.description: Get every past attempt of your submission for one assignment, oldest to newest, with scores and timestamps. Read-only. Use get_my_submission for just the latest attempt.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: list_submission_attachments
tools.description: List files attached to your submission for one assignment, with names, sizes and download URLs. Read-only. Pass a URL from here to download_submission_attachment to save a file.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_originality_report
tools.description: Get the plagiarism or originality score (e.g. Turnitin) for your submission and its attachments. Read-only. Returns no report if no originality tool is enabled on the assignment.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: get_rubric_assessment
tools.description: Get the rubric scoring applied to your submission, criterion by criterion, with points and comments. Read-only. Use get_rubric to see the full rubric before you submit.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: list_submission_comments
tools.description: List comments on your submission from your instructor and others, with author and time. Read-only. Comment text is fenced as untrusted. Reply with post_submission_comment.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: mark_submission_read
tools.description: Mark your submission, including any new grade or comments, as read so the unread badge clears. Only affects you.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

tools.name: submit_assignment_text
tools.description: Submit text for an online text-entry assignment, exactly as given; the tool never writes content for you. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: submit_assignment_url
tools.description: Submit a website URL for an assignment that accepts URL submissions. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

url.description: Full web address to submit, starting with https://.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: submit_assignment_file
tools.description: Upload a local file and submit it to an assignment in one step. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. To upload now and submit later, use upload_submission_file. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local file

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: upload_submission_file
tools.description: Upload a local file into an assignment's submission slot without submitting it. Nothing is submitted and your instructor sees nothing yet. Returns a file_id that can be submitted later through raw_canvas_request; submit_assignment_file uploads and submits in one step.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload, e.g. "C:/Users/me/essay.pdf".

tools.name: post_submission_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on your own submission for an assignment, optionally with files attached. Your instructor sees it. To attach a file, upload it first with upload_comment_attachment. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

comment.description: Comment text, visible to your instructor.

file_ids.description: Optional file IDs returned by upload_comment_attachment, to attach to this comment.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: upload_comment_attachment
tools.description: Upload a local file so it can be attached to a comment on your submission. Returns a file ID; nothing is visible to anyone until you call post_submission_comment with that ID in file_ids.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload, e.g. "C:/Users/me/essay.pdf".

tools.name: download_submission_attachment
tools.description: Download one file attached to your submission and save it to local disk. Returns the saved path. Get the URL from list_submission_attachments.

url.description: Download URL of the attachment: the attachments[].url field from list_submission_attachments or get_my_submission.

filename.description: File name to save as. Defaults to the attachment's own name.

tools.name: get_all_grades
tools.description: Get your current and final grades for every active course in one call, including unposted grades where Canvas shows them. Read-only. Use get_course_grade_breakdown to see how one course's grade is calculated.

tools.name: calculate_gpa
tools.description: Calculate your GPA on a 4.0 scale from your current Canvas grades, weighted by credit hours. Read-only. Uses the letter grade Canvas shows, or converts the percent (93+ A, 90 A-, 87 B+ and so on). Supports what-if grades and extra points for honors or AP classes. Pass-fail courses are listed as excluded.

credits.description: Credit hours per course, keyed by course ID, name or code, e.g. {"Calculus I": 4, "ENG101": 3}. Courses not listed use default_credits.

default_credits.description: Credit hours for courses not in credits. Default 3.

what_if.description: Pretend grades, keyed by course ID, name or code. Each value is a letter ("B+") or a percent (88), e.g. {"Chemistry": "A-"}.

extra_points.description: Extra grade points for weighted GPA, keyed like credits, e.g. {"AP Biology": 1, "Honors English": 0.5}. Leave empty for an unweighted GPA.

use_final_score.description: True to use the final score, which counts missing work as zero, instead of the current score. Default false.

tools.name: get_course_grade_breakdown
tools.description: Break down your grade in one course: each assignment group's weight, your points earned vs possible, and its weighted contribution to the total. Read-only. Use compute_needed_score to plan toward a target grade.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: what_if_grade
tools.description: Enter a hypothetical score on one assignment and get your recalculated course grade, with Canvas applying group weights and drop rules. Writes a what-if score only you can see; it is not a real grade. Undo with reset_what_if_grades. Canvas treats this as expensive; for pure math with no writes, use compute_needed_score.

tools.name: reset_what_if_grades
tools.description: Clear every what-if score you entered in a course so Canvas shows your real grades again. Only affects your own view.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_grading_standard
tools.description: Get the letter-grade scale for a course, i.e. the percentage needed for each letter such as A- or B+. Read-only.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_grading_periods
tools.description: List a course's grading periods (e.g. quarters) with start, end and close dates. Read-only. Returns an empty list if the course does not use grading periods.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_my_assignment_analytics
tools.description: Get your score on each assignment next to the class median, min and max, plus whether you submitted on time. Read-only. Returns an error if course analytics are disabled at your school.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_my_activity_analytics
tools.description: Get your page views and participations in a course, counted per day. Read-only. Returns an error if course analytics are disabled at your school.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_my_communication_analytics
tools.description: Get daily counts of messages between you and the instructor in a course. Read-only. Returns an error if course analytics are disabled at your school.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_unposted_grades
tools.description: Get scores your instructor entered but has not released yet, where your enrollment can see them. Read-only. Usually empty for students; use get_all_grades for released grades.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: compute_needed_score
tools.description: Calculate the average you need on remaining ungraded work in a course to reach a target final percentage, accounting for group weights. Pure math with no writes. Use what_if_grade to test one specific score with Canvas itself.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: grade_impact_ranking
tools.description: Rank a course's ungraded and upcoming assignments by how much each point moves your final grade. Read-only. Shows where effort pays most; study_priority_ranking does this across all courses with urgency added.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_grade_trend
tools.description: List graded assignments in a course in date order with a running average, so you can see whether your grade is rising or falling. Read-only.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: List Classic Quizzes in a course with due dates, time limits, allowed attempts and points. Read-only. For New Quizzes, use list_new_quizzes. This server never takes quizzes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.description: Get one Classic Quiz: instructions, time limit, allowed attempts, dates and when results are shown. Read-only. Instructions are fenced as untrusted. This server never takes quizzes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_my_quiz_submission
tools.description: Get your latest submission for a quiz: score, attempt number, state and timing. Read-only. Use list_my_quiz_submissions for every attempt.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: list_my_quiz_submissions
tools.description: List all your attempts on a quiz with the score for each. Read-only. Use get_my_quiz_submission for just the latest.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_quiz_submission_time
tools.description: Get the time remaining and end time for an in-progress timed quiz attempt. Read-only. Needs the submission ID from get_my_quiz_submission.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

submission_id.description: Quiz submission ID (numeric string), from get_my_quiz_submission.

tools.name: list_quiz_questions
tools.description: List a quiz's questions so you can review a completed, graded attempt. Read-only and never used to take a quiz. Canvas hides questions unless the instructor allows review, so this often returns a permission error or nothing.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_quiz_extensions
tools.description: Get extra time or extra attempts granted to you on a quiz (accommodations). Read-only. Returns an empty list if none were granted.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_quiz_ip_filters
tools.description: Get IP address restrictions on a quiz (used for lab-only or proctored exams), so you know where you can take it. Read-only.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_quiz_assignment_overrides
tools.description: Get section- or student-specific due dates for quizzes in a course. Read-only. Use get_my_override for the dates that apply to you on one assignment.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_assignment_overrides.description: Optional quiz IDs to limit the result to, e.g. ["123", "456"].

tools.name: list_new_quizzes
tools.description: List New Quizzes assessments in a course with due dates, points and question counts. Read-only. New Quizzes is a separate service from Classic Quizzes (list_quizzes) and may not be enabled at your school.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_new_quiz
tools.description: Get details for one New Quizzes assessment: title, instructions, points and timing. Read-only. Uses the Quiz LTI API, which some schools do not expose to students. For Classic Quizzes use get_quiz.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: get_new_quiz_items
tools.description: List the questions in a New Quizzes assessment. Read-only. Most schools only allow this for instructors, so students usually get a permission error.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

quiz_id.description: Quiz ID (numeric string). Get it from list_quizzes, or list_new_quizzes for New Quizzes.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List discussion topics in a course with unread counts and whether you must post before seeing replies. Read-only. Set only_announcements for announcements; read a thread with get_full_topic_view.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

only_announcements.description: If true, return announcements instead of discussion topics.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get one discussion topic: its prompt, author, posting rules and unread count, without the replies. Read-only. The prompt is fenced as untrusted text. Use get_full_topic_view to read the whole thread, or list_topics to find topic IDs.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

tools.name: get_full_topic_view
tools.description: Get an entire discussion thread, all entries and nested replies, in one request. Read-only. Much lighter on rate limits than paging through list_entries. All participant text is fenced as untrusted.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of discussion entries to include.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: List top-level entries in a discussion topic, page by page. Read-only. Entry text is fenced as untrusted. Prefer get_full_topic_view to read a whole thread at once.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: list_entry_replies
tools.description: List the replies under one discussion entry, oldest first. Read-only. Bodies are fenced as untrusted text. To read a whole thread at once, use get_full_topic_view instead.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: post_entry
tools.description: Post a new top-level entry to a course discussion. Visible to the whole class. Use reply_to_entry to answer someone's entry. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

message.description: Message text. Plain text or simple HTML.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: reply_to_entry
tools.description: Reply to one discussion entry. Visible to the whole class. Use post_entry for a new top-level post. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

message.description: Message text. Plain text or simple HTML.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: edit_my_entry
tools.description: Replace the text of one of your own discussion entries, if the course allows editing. The new text is visible to the whole class. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

message.description: Message text. Plain text or simple HTML.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: delete_my_entry
tools.description: Delete one of your own discussion entries, if the course allows it. Classmates see that an entry was removed. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: rate_entry
tools.description: Like (rating 1) or remove your like (rating 0) on a discussion entry, where the instructor enabled ratings. Others see the like count.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

tools.name: mark_topic_read
tools.description: Mark a discussion topic as read for you. Only affects your unread counts. Use mark_all_entries_read to also clear every reply.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

tools.name: mark_all_entries_read
tools.description: Mark every entry in a discussion topic as read for you. Only affects your unread counts.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

tools.name: mark_entry_read
tools.description: Mark one discussion entry as read for you. Only affects your unread counts.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

entry_id.description: Discussion entry ID (numeric string). Get it from get_full_topic_view or list_entries.

tools.name: subscribe_topic
tools.description: Subscribe to a discussion topic so you are notified about new replies. Only affects you. Reverse with unsubscribe_topic.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

tools.name: unsubscribe_topic
tools.description: Stop getting notifications for new replies in a discussion topic. Only affects you; the topic and your posts are unchanged. Reverse with subscribe_topic.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

tools.name: list_announcements
tools.description: List announcements from one or more courses in a date range, newest first, with title, author and body. Read-only. Bodies are fenced as untrusted text. Without dates it covers the last 30 days; without course_ids it covers all active courses.

course_ids.description: Course IDs; omit for all active courses

start_date.description: Start of the range, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-11-01".

end_date.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-11-30".

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_unread_discussion_count
tools.description: Get the unread entry count for each discussion topic in a course. Read-only and cheap. Use get_full_topic_view to read a topic.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List your Canvas Inbox conversations, newest first, with subject, participants, last message preview and unread state. Read-only. Use get_conversation for the full thread.

filter.description: Optional filter by course or user, e.g. "course_12345".

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get the full message thread for one Inbox conversation, with authors and times. Read-only unless mark_as_read is true. Message bodies are fenced as untrusted.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a new Canvas Inbox message, e.g. to a professor or classmate. Recipients get it immediately. Get recipient IDs from find_recipients; to answer an existing thread, use reply_to_conversation. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

body.description: Message body text. Plain text or simple HTML.

course_id.description: Course context, recommended

separate_threads.description: Send individually rather than as a group thread

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Reply within an existing Canvas Inbox conversation. Every participant receives it. Use send_message to start a new thread. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

body.description: Message body text. Plain text or simple HTML.

included_message_ids.description: Optional IDs of earlier messages in the thread to quote in this reply, from get_conversation.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: find_recipients
tools.description: Search by name for people you are allowed to message, optionally within one course. Read-only. Returns the user IDs that send_message and add_recipients need.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: add_recipients
tools.description: Add more people to an existing Inbox conversation so they receive its messages. Get user IDs from find_recipients. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

recipients.description: User IDs to add, from find_recipients.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.description: Mark one Inbox conversation as read. Only affects you; the sender is not notified. Reverse with mark_conversation_unread.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: mark_conversation_unread
tools.description: Mark one Inbox conversation as unread so it shows up again. Only affects you. Reverse with mark_conversation_read.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: star_conversation
tools.description: Star an Inbox conversation so it appears under the "starred" scope. Only affects you. Reverse with unstar_conversation.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: unstar_conversation
tools.description: Remove the star from an Inbox conversation. Only affects you; the conversation itself is unchanged. Reverse with star_conversation.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive an Inbox conversation so it leaves your inbox view; it stays under the archived scope. Only affects you.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Delete an Inbox conversation from your own inbox. Other participants keep their copy. Cannot be undone. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: get_unread_conversation_count
tools.description: Get the number of unread Canvas Inbox conversations. Read-only and very cheap. Use list_conversations with scope unread to see them.

tools.name: batch_update_conversations
tools.description: Apply one action (mark read or unread, star, unstar, archive or delete) to many Inbox conversations at once. Only affects your own inbox. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

conversation_ids.description: Inbox conversation IDs (numeric strings) from list_conversations.

event.description: Action to apply to every listed conversation. "destroy" deletes them from your inbox for good.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List calendar events, or assignment due dates with type=assignment, in a date range (default: the next 14 days). Read-only. Filter to specific courses with course_ids.

end_date.description: End of the range, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-11-30".

type.description: "event" (default) for calendar events, or "assignment" for assignment due dates.

course_ids.description: Course IDs (numeric strings) to include. Get them from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_calendar_event
tools.description: Get one calendar event: title, start and end time, location, description and the course it belongs to. Read-only. Get event_id from list_calendar_events.

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

tools.name: create_personal_event
tools.description: Create an event on your own Canvas calendar (only you see it). Returns the new event with its ID. Use update_calendar_event to change it later.

title.description: Event title, e.g. "Study for BIO midterm".

tools.name: update_calendar_event
tools.description: Change the title, times or description of a calendar event you created. Only events you own can be changed; course events return a permission error. Fields you omit stay the same.

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep the current one.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event you own, such as a personal event. Cannot be undone. Course events return a permission error. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_appointment_groups
tools.description: List appointment groups you can sign up for, such as office hours or advising slots, with open time slots. Read-only. Book a slot with reserve_appointment_slot.

scope.description: "reservable" (default: groups you can still book) or "manageable".

include_past.description: If true, also include appointment groups whose slots are in the past.

tools.name: get_appointment_group
tools.description: Get one appointment group (office hours or advising) with its time slots and remaining capacity. Read-only. Book a slot with reserve_appointment_slot using a slot ID from here.

group_id.description: Appointment group ID (numeric string). Get it from list_appointment_groups.

tools.name: reserve_appointment_slot
tools.description: Book an office hours or advising time slot. The instructor sees the booking. Get slot IDs from get_appointment_group; cancel with cancel_reservation. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

comments.description: Optional note for the instructor, e.g. what you want to discuss.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancel an appointment slot you booked. The instructor can see the cancellation. Get event_id from list_my_reservations. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

cancel_reason.description: Optional reason shown to the instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: list_my_reservations
tools.description: List the appointment slots you have booked, from the past week through the next 60 days. Read-only. Cancel one with cancel_reservation.

tools.name: get_course_pace
tools.description: Get the pacing plan for a self-paced course: suggested days for each module and the resulting dates. Read-only. Returns an error if course pacing is not used.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_course_files
tools.description: List files in a course (slides, readings, handouts) with names, sizes, types and IDs, optionally filtered by name or type. Read-only. Save one with download_file, or all with download_all_course_files.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List every folder in a course's Files area with its path, file count and ID. Read-only. Use get_folder_tree for a readable outline of folders and files together.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: get_folder
tools.description: Get one folder's details: full path, parent folder, and how many files and subfolders it holds. Read-only. Get folder_id from list_folders.

folder_id.description: Folder ID (numeric string). Get it from list_folders.

tools.name: get_folder_tree
tools.description: Show a course's folders and files as an indented outline. Read-only. A good first look at what material exists; use list_course_files for IDs and details.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

max_depth.description: How many folder levels deep to go.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Get details for one file: name, size, content type, created and updated dates, and download URL. Read-only. Use download_file to save it locally.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

tools.name: get_file_public_url
tools.description: Get a temporary public download link for a file that works without logging in. Read-only, but anyone with the link can download the file until it expires.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download one Canvas file and save it to local disk. Returns the saved path and size. Get file_id from list_course_files or list_my_files.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

dest_dir.description: Local folder to save into. Defaults to the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR).

tools.name: read_course_file
tools.description: Read the text of a Canvas file so you can summarize it, quiz from it or answer questions about it. Read-only. Works with PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx, including speaker notes), web pages and plain-text files up to 25 MB. Long files come back in parts: call again with next_offset. Scanned PDFs have no text. Get file_id from list_course_files or list_module_items.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

offset.description: Character to start from, for reading the next part of a long file. Use next_offset from the previous call. Default 0.

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one call. Default 30000, maximum 100000.

tools.name: list_my_files
tools.description: List files in your personal Canvas storage (not course files), with names, sizes and IDs. Read-only. For course files use list_course_files.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: upload_to_my_files
tools.description: Upload a local file into your personal Canvas storage. Only you can see it until you share or submit it. Returns the new file's ID.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload, e.g. "C:/Users/me/essay.pdf".

parent_folder_path.description: Folder path inside your storage, e.g. "notes/spring". Omit for the top level.

tools.name: get_storage_quota
tools.description: Get your personal Canvas storage quota and how much of it is used. Read-only.

tools.name: delete_my_file
tools.description: Delete a file from your personal Canvas storage. Cannot be undone. Get file_id from list_my_files. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in your personal Canvas storage (not in a course). Only you can see it. Returns the new folder with its ID. Upload into it with upload_to_my_files.

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the folder to create this one inside, from list_my_files or an earlier create_folder. Omit for the top level.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the wiki pages in a course with titles, URL slugs and last-updated dates. Read-only. Read one page with get_page_content using its url slug.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

search_term.description: Optional text filter on names or titles (at least 2 characters, case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read a course page as plain text (converted from HTML), with its title and last-updated time. Read-only. The body is fenced as untrusted. Find page slugs with list_pages.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

tools.name: list_page_revisions
tools.description: List the edit history of one course page: revision numbers, editors and dates. Read-only. Students often cannot see page history, in which case Canvas returns a permission error. Read a revision with get_page_revision.
